title: Shared-Visit Rate for the Electrical Diagnostic Fee: Workmanship Warranties Billing Clause
content:
**Clause.** Under the Workmanship Warranties, the electrical diagnostic fee in an electrical diagnostic charge on a Collision Lifetime Workmanship Warranty or Certified Structural Lifetime Warranty is charged according to the number of not-covered findings the coverage's inspections recorded on the date of its most recent not-covered finding: three or more, the electrical diagnostic fee is halved and rounded down to the whole dollar; exactly two, the electrical diagnostic fee is multiplied by the shared-visit share of 0.75 and rounded to the cent; one, the electrical diagnostic fee is charged in full.

## The clause by count

| Not-covered findings recorded on that inspection date | Electrical diagnostic fee as charged |
|---|---|
| one | charged in full |
| exactly two | multiplied by 0.75, rounded to the cent |
| three or more | halved, rounded down to the whole dollar |

## What is counted

- **The date.** The inspection date of the coverage's most recent not-covered finding.
- **The findings.** Every inspection on the coverage dated that day that found a concern not covered, of whatever kind; covered findings that day are not counted.

## Worked figures (hypothetical electrical diagnostic fee of USD 101.40)

| Not-covered findings that day | Calculation | Fee as charged |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | in full | USD 101.40 |
| 2 | USD 101.40 multiplied by 0.75 is USD 76.05 | USD 76.05 |
| 3 | USD 101.40 halved is USD 50.70, rounded down to the whole dollar | USD 50.00 |
